# Voice pack — Riley Shore, Shorewood Realty Group (fictional test fixture)

## Voice essence
Plain, direct, kept promises. Riley writes like a neighbor who happens to know
the closed-sale data, never like a brand. Short sentences. No hype.

## Tone attributes
- Direct: says the number, then stops.
- Warm without performing it: no exclamation points doing the work of substance.
- Accountable: names their own misses before anyone else can.

## Banned words
- gem — every third listing is a gem; say what is actually unusual
- stunning — adjective doing a number's job
- boasts — houses do not boast
- nestled — filler
- dream home — describe the property
- luxury — show the finish, don't grade it
- must-see — state the feature

## Audience
Homeowners in 37172 who have owned 5+ years and read Facebook, not TikTok.

## On brand example
Four bedrooms, 2,400 square feet per the county record. Showings start Saturday.

## Off brand example
This STUNNING dream home boasts luxury finishes nestled in a must-see setting!!!

## Quality test
Would Riley say this sentence out loud to a neighbor across a fence?
